-- CREDENTIAL -- 
create DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL adlssynapse2
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

--- CREATE EXTERNAL DATA Source --
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ext_112
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'https://databdataftrial.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse',
    CREDENTIAL = adlssynapse1
)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET   
)
